description: This file defines the AuthSchemeResolver class within the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains logic for selecting and resolving authentication schemes based on service traits or operation-level settings, supporting multiple authentication methods such as SigV4, SigV4a, Bearer, and noAuth. The class includes methods to determine scheme compatibility and handle credential validation, with dependencies on external identity and promise classes.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolver
classes.description: Implements logic for resolving and selecting AWS authentication schemes based on configuration, identities, and environment.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Chooses a normalized auth scheme from a list of candidates based on compatibility and provided arguments.

methods.name: isCompatibleAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks whether a given auth scheme is compatible, considering environment and available credentials.

methods.name: getIncompatibilityMessage
methods.description: Returns an explanatory message if an auth scheme is incompatible.

methods.name: hasAwsCredentialIdentity
methods.description: Determines if valid AWS credentials are available.

methods.name: hasBearerTokenIdentity
methods.description: Determines if a bearer token identity is available.
